subject: Procedure division structure
notes: §14.2.2 SR13 (A procedure division in an interface/instance/factory definition not in a method definition shall be object-oriented format). The CobolOO.g4 productions for FACTORY, OBJECT and INTERFACE admit only `PROCEDURE DIVISION DOT methodDefinition*`. Probes: OBJECT PD with a DISPLAY statement (b2/sr13_objstmts.cob), OBJECT `PROCEDURE DIVISION USING A.` (sr13_objusing.cob) and FACTORY `PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING A.` (sr13_factreturning.cob) all refused at parse (COBOL0001/0307 - loud, parse-level wording).
